metadata.title: Minimalist Studio Portrait with Avian Element

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio portrait featuring a young man with dark hair sitting cross-legged on a white floor. He wears a black tank top, light-wash cuffed jeans, white socks, and black leather shoes. A large black raven is captured in mid-flight or perched near his shoulder, creating a stark contrast against the bright, neutral background.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark silhouette of the raven against the bright white void.
The triangular composition formed by the subject's seated posture.
The textural contrast between smooth skin, denim fabric, and iridescent feathers.
The direct, intense gaze of the subject towards the camera lens.
coreInvariants: Presence of a large black bird (crow or raven).
Soft, diffused studio lighting with minimal harsh shadows.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a grounded, seated position.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the raven's wingspan serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the arms to the shoes, then sweeps upward following the raven's wing back to the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the subject, emphasizing isolation and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the deep blacks and bright whites.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution studio photograph of a young man with dark medium-length hair sitting on a white floor against a white background. He is wearing a black tank top, light blue cuffed jeans, white socks, and black leather derby shoes. A black raven with wings slightly spread is positioned near his right shoulder. Lighting should be soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist sans-serif font in black, placed in the upper negative space to maintain the clean editorial aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white and seamless?
Is the raven's silhouette sharp and distinct?
Are the jeans cuffed high enough to show the white socks?
Is the lighting soft without heavy drop shadows?

mustRedesign: Avoid any visible logos on the clothing or shoes.
Ensure the bird does not look taxidermied; it must have a sense of life or motion.

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's eyes
Balanced composition within the white space

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the bird's wings.
Ensure the white socks are bright and clean.
Verify the texture of the denim is visible.
Confirm the background is a true high-key white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key White Background + [Subject Description] + [Black Avian Element] + Minimalist Fashion Styling.
